mechanism: Cells sensing a locally high Turing morphogen raise their cortical contractility and constrict (apical constriction / differential tension), buckling a flat monolayer into folds and tubes with no net growth.
why_inexpressible: shape_energy_3d exposes Gamma and Lambda as single global scalars (one value for the entire mesh, lines 80-81), and the cell set's state block is only {chem, cen, area} — there is no per-cell contractility slot to route a pattern into. The one operator that reads the morphogen, morphogen_growth_3d, EMITs into volume/growth, never into tension; and no EMIT=force operator reads a per-cell chem scalar and writes it into shape_energy's Gamma. So the morphogen can only inflate (=> P2_BUFFER_SATURATED) or destabilize reaction settings (=> DIVERGED); it can never contract. The missing pieces are a per-cell mechanics state block on the cell set plus a force-emitting coupler that reads chem and modulates Gamma per cell.
wanted_for: Fills the empty 'patterned mechanics / shape at conserved volume' cell of the map. The whole frontier is either mechanics-only-with-no-pattern (C93160bc7edb, C6a07112cc06) or pattern-that-only-drives-growth-and-saturates (Cf4907ea516e, Cd13473bf1c3). This is the one region no admissible run has reached: can differential contractility make folds/tubes WITHOUT growth, sidestepping both refusal codes.

params.chem_index: which chem channel drives tension (0 = activator a)
params.gamma_gain: per-cell contractility scale: local Gamma = base + gamma_gain*chem[chem_index], routing the morphogen into cortical tension instead of volume
params.apical_bias: fraction of the contractile force placed on the apical vertex ring vs basal (1.0 = pure apical constriction, 0.5 = isotropic in-plane)
params.clamp: max multiple of base Gamma per step, keeping the relax iteration inside the integrable region to prevent DIVERGED

acceptance_test: On a SIMPLE flat single-layer disc of 60 cells with divide_3d off and growth rate 0, paint a central 7-cell patch to chem[a]=1 and set gamma_gain so patch Gamma = 3x the surrounding ring. Run 200 frames. PASS if patch apical area shrinks to <=0.5x its start, the patch centroid deflects out-of-plane by >=1 cell diameter (a pit forms), total mesh volume stays within +/-5% (no growth => no SATURATED), and the shape_energy relax residual stays bounded (no DIVERGED); control gamma_gain=0 stays flat (deflection <0.1 cell diameter).
